description: Update app/hotels/[id]/page.tsx to fetch hotel detail and rooms from the real API, remove generateStaticParams, handle 404, and update RoomCard.tsx to use the API RoomAvailability type. Independent of FEAT-001 (no shared code changes).
steps:
2. UPDATE app/hotels/[id]/page.tsx:

  a) Remove the `generateStaticParams` export entirely — no replacement needed. The page will render dynamically (on-demand) for every id.

  b) Remove all imports from '../mock' and '../../search/mock'.

  c) Import `fetchHotelDetail`, `fetchHotelRooms`, `HotelDetail`, `RoomAvailability` from '@/app/lib/api/search'.

  d) Replace the mock-data lookup at the top of `HotelDetailPage` with:
  ```ts
  const [detail, rooms] = await Promise.all([
    fetchHotelDetail(id),
    fetchHotelRooms(id),
  ]);
  if (!detail) notFound();
  ```

  e) The `lowestPrice` computation is unchanged — it uses `rooms` array the same way.

  f) The reviews section: the backend does not yet expose a reviews endpoint, so remove the reviews section entirely from the JSX (or render an empty-reviews placeholder: 'No reviews yet. Be the first to share your experience.'). Remove HotelReview import and HOTEL_REVIEWS usage. Remove the `avgRating`, `countFor`, `categoryAvg` computed variables that relied on `reviews`.

  g) `detail.nearbyAttractions`, `detail.policies`, `detail.amenities`, `detail.checkInTime`, `detail.checkOutTime`, `detail.address`, `detail.description` — these map 1:1 from the HotelDetail type. Use null-coalescing where appropriate:
     - `detail.amenities ?? []`
     - `detail.nearbyAttractions ?? []`
     - `detail.policies ?? []`

  h) The RoomCard receives `room: RoomAvailability` — the shape is identical to the old `RoomType`, so no prop changes needed on the call site.
acceptance_criteria: `npx next build` completes with no TypeScript errors
RoomCard.tsx imports RoomAvailability from @/app/lib/api/search, not from ../../mock
fetchHotelDetail returns null on 404 and the page correctly calls notFound()
Hotel detail page still renders all non-reviews sections (gallery, header, rooms, amenities, location, policies)
verification: npx next build from c:\Users\Pkaka\music\hotel-os — must complete with exit code 0 and no TypeScript errors
findings: Next.js 16 with cacheComponents:true requires `export const instant = false` on any page that performs blocking server fetches. Added to hotels/[id]/page.tsx to satisfy the partial-prerender validator during build. Build passes with /hotels/[id] correctly showing as Partial Prerender (◐).
